scope: Numerical acceptance of the shipped educational example only; no building or Oomakhi structural design acceptance.
user_authority: Refine the shipped example mesh and establish a justified convergence tolerance; retain the issue until equilibrium passes, then build and install.

method.geometry_material_loading: Unchanged constraint_section_print example; only native mesh sizing changes.
method.solver: Real CalculiX 2.23 via stock FemToolsCcx.run(), solver test_mode disabled
method.result_source: Unmodified solver-reported Section Print totals from Mesh.dat; no runtime deck editing, stress integration, reconstructed forces or substituted resultants.
method.manual_relevance: Section Print integrates extrapolated/averaged nodal stresses; the manual's curved-beam example demonstrates coarse-mesh equilibrium error and improvement with refinement.
method.rerun: FREECAD_9BP_OUTPUT=<new-directory> FREECAD_9BP_SECTION_SIZE=<mm> pixi run build/release/bin/FreeCADCmd -P tests/src/Mod/Fem -t StockSectionEquilibrium. Omit SECTION_SIZE to test the frozen shipped mesh. Use isolated FreeCAD user/system profiles.
method.normalization: Euclidean norm of vector error divided by the norm of the corresponding exact nonzero resultant. Includes parasitic zero-component errors, not individual relative component tests.

acceptance.justification: An explicitly chosen 1% example accuracy target, not a universal engineering rule or exact finite-element conservation claim. The selected mesh achieves 0.4411% force, 0.0813% origin-moment and 0.0104% centroid-moment error against exact free-body equilibrium, leaving over 2x force margin. Two finer section meshes independently decrease the force error to 0.2429% and 0.1365%; successive force changes are 0.2027% and 0.1065%, and origin-moment changes 0.0070% and 0.0355%, all below the separate 0.5% stability bound. Original coarse 33.89% error and 2.5 mm local 1.51% error still fail the target. No Richardson order or asymptotic error bound is claimed for these unstructured local meshes. The 24k-element candidate balances demonstrated accuracy and runnable example cost; 1.75 mm was not selected despite passing 1% because it has less margin.

shipped_asset.generation: Native FemMesh.write(.unv), gzip -n; native Fem.read after temporary decompression. No new mesh/solver dependencies.
shipped_asset.roundtrip_verified: Frozen UNV read gives exactly the same solver-reported totals as the original native Gmsh mesh.
shipped_asset.coarse_fixture: Original Python mesh and compact golden input remain solely as an explicit writer regression fixture, not the shipped setup mesh.

additional_controls.fresh_native_gmsh_regeneration_at_select: Pass on committed +144 build: force0.4660%, origin moment0.1201%, centroid moment0.0227%. Small native mesher variation remains well within1%; frozen shipped mesh remains deterministic.
additional_controls.global_refinement: Independent 1.75 mm global mesh (126406 volumes) gave0.6961% force error, consistent with convergence. An optional 1.25 mm global solve was stopped after seven minutes because of excessive memory/swap cost; no result or pass is claimed for it. The completed local-refinement study through0.625 mm is the acceptance evidence.
